ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, $AB$ is a chord of $\odot O$. Through point $O$, construct $OC\perp OA$, with $OC$ intersecting $AB$ at point $P$, and $CP=BC$. Point $Q$ is a point on the arc $\overset{\frown}{AmB}$. Prove that: $BC$ is a tangent to $\odot O$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution} Proof: Connect OB,\\
since OA = OB,\\
it follows that $\angle OAB = \angle OBA$,\\
since PC = CB,\\
it follows that $\angle CPB = \angle PBC$,\\
since $\angle APO = \angle CPB$,\\
it follows that $\angle APO = \angle CBP$,\\
since OC $\perp$ OA,\\
it follows that $\angle AOP = 90^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle OAP + \angle APO = 90^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle CBP + \angle ABO = 90^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle CBO = 90^\circ$,\\
thus, \boxed{BC \text{ is the tangent to the circle } O}.

图像描述：图中有一个以 O 为圆心的圆，A、B、Q 在圆上，AB 是圆的一条弦并与从 C 经过 P 到 O 的直线相交于 P。线段 OC 经过 O、P、C，且图中 OA 与 OC 垂直。C 在圆外左侧，并连接了 CB；还画出了 BQ，Q 位于右下方圆弧上，但本证明中不需要使用 Q。

推理：连接 OB。因为 A、B 都在圆 O 上，所以 OA 和 OB 都是半径，故 OA = OB。因此三角形 AOB 是等腰三角形，得到 ∠OAB = ∠ABO。又因为 P 在 AB 上，所以 ∠OAP = ∠OAB，因此 ∠OAP = ∠ABO。

由已知 CP = BC，可知三角形 CPB 是等腰三角形，所以 ∠CPB = ∠PBC。由于直线 AB 与直线 OC 在 P 点相交，∠CPB 与 ∠APO 是对顶角，因此 ∠CPB = ∠APO。于是 ∠APO = ∠PBC。

又因为 OC ⟂ OA，且 P 在 OC 上，所以 ∠AOP = 90°。在直角三角形 AOP 中，∠OAP + ∠APO = 90°。将上面得到的 ∠OAP = ∠ABO 和 ∠APO = ∠PBC 代入，得 ∠ABO + ∠PBC = 90°。

因为 A、P、B 共线，所以射线 BA 与 BP 在同一直线上，故 ∠ABO + ∠PBC 正好组成 ∠OBC。因此 ∠OBC = 90°，即 OB ⟂ BC。又 OB 是圆 O 在点 B 处的半径，所以 BC 垂直于过切点 B 的半径 OB，故 BC 是圆 O 的切线。

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: OA is drawn from center O to top point A of the circle, OC is perpendicular to OA and passes through P before reaching external point C, while A-P-B are collinear with B on the circle. Set coordinates with O = (0,0), OA vertical, A = (0,r), and OC horizontal to the left. Let P = (-p,0) and C = (-c,0), where c > p > 0. The line AP has equation through A and P; its second intersection with x^2 + y^2 = r^2 is B. Parametrize AP as A + t(P-A), giving B = (-2pr^2/(p^2+r^2), r(p^2-r^2)/(p^2+r^2)). Now impose the text condition CP = BC: CP = c-p and BC^2 = (x_B+c)^2 + y_B^2. Since B lies on the circle, x_B^2 + y_B^2 = r^2, so BC^2 = c^2 + 2cx_B + r^2. Equating with (c-p)^2 gives c = (p^2+r^2)/(2p). Then compute the dot product of OB and CB: OB · CB = (x_B,y_B) · (-c-x_B,-y_B) = -cx_B - r^2. Substituting x_B = -2pr^2/(p^2+r^2) and c = (p^2+r^2)/(2p) gives OB · CB = 0. Thus OB ⟂ BC, so BC is tangent to the circle at B.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一圆，圆心为 O。A 在圆的上方，OA 竖直；从 O 向左作水平线 OC，且 OC 与 OA 垂直。水平线 OC 与弦 AB 相交于 P，点 C 在圆外左侧，P 在 C 与 O 之间。A、P、B 三点共线，B 在圆的左下方。Q 位于右侧圆弧上，但本证明中不需要使用 Q。

推理：按照图形建立坐标系。设 O=(0,0)，半径 OA=r，因此 A=(0,r)。因为 OC 垂直 OA 且向左，令 P=(-p,0)，C=(-c,0)，其中 c>p>0。圆的方程为 x^2+y^2=r^2。

直线 AP 可参数化为 A+t(P-A)=(-pt, r(1-t))。代入圆方程：p^2t^2+r^2(1-t)^2=r^2，化简得 (p^2+r^2)t^2-2r^2t=0。除去 t=0 对应点 A，第二交点 B 对应 t=2r^2/(p^2+r^2)，故 B=(-2pr^2/(p^2+r^2), r(p^2-r^2)/(p^2+r^2))。

由题设 CP=BC。因为 CP=c-p，且 B 在圆上，所以 BC^2=(x_B+c)^2+y_B^2=c^2+2cx_B+x_B^2+y_B^2=c^2+2cx_B+r^2。于是 (c-p)^2=c^2+2cx_B+r^2。代入 x_B=-2pr^2/(p^2+r^2)，解得 c=(p^2+r^2)/(2p)。

现在计算向量 OB 与 CB 的点积。OB=(x_B,y_B)，CB=C-B=(-c-x_B,-y_B)。因此 OB·CB=x_B(-c-x_B)+y_B(-y_B)=-cx_B-(x_B^2+y_B^2)=-cx_B-r^2。代入 x_B=-2pr^2/(p^2+r^2) 与 c=(p^2+r^2)/(2p)，得到 cx_B=-r^2，所以 OB·CB=0。故 OB⊥CB。

由于 OB 是圆 O 在点 B 处的半径，且 BC 垂直于 OB，所以 BC 是圆 O 在 B 点处的切线。

method.CoT_answer_check_final:
图像描述：图中有一圆，圆心为 O。A 在圆的上方，OA 竖直；从 O 向左作水平线 OC，且 OC 与 OA 垂直。水平线 OC 与弦 AB 相交于 P，点 C 在圆外左侧，P 在 C 与 O 之间。A、P、B 三点共线，B 在圆的左下方。Q 位于右侧圆弧上，但本证明中不需要使用 Q。

推理：按照图形建立坐标系。设 O=(0,0)，半径 OA=r，因此 A=(0,r)。因为 OC 垂直 OA 且向左，令 P=(-p,0)，C=(-c,0)，其中 c>p>0。圆的方程为 x^2+y^2=r^2。

直线 AP 可参数化为 A+t(P-A)=(-pt, r(1-t))。代入圆方程：p^2t^2+r^2(1-t)^2=r^2，化简得 (p^2+r^2)t^2-2r^2t=0。除去 t=0 对应点 A，第二交点 B 对应 t=2r^2/(p^2+r^2)，故 B=(-2pr^2/(p^2+r^2), r(p^2-r^2)/(p^2+r^2))。

由题设 CP=BC。因为 CP=c-p，且 B 在圆上，所以 BC^2=(x_B+c)^2+y_B^2=c^2+2cx_B+x_B^2+y_B^2=c^2+2cx_B+r^2。于是 (c-p)^2=c^2+2cx_B+r^2。代入 x_B=-2pr^2/(p^2+r^2)，解得 c=(p^2+r^2)/(2p)。

现在计算向量 OB 与 CB 的点积。OB=(x_B,y_B)，CB=C-B=(-c-x_B,-y_B)。因此 OB·CB=x_B(-c-x_B)+y_B(-y_B)=-cx_B-(x_B^2+y_B^2)=-cx_B-r^2。代入 x_B=-2pr^2/(p^2+r^2) 与 c=(p^2+r^2)/(2p)，得到 cx_B=-r^2，所以 OB·CB=0。故 OB⊥CB。

由于 OB 是圆 O 在点 B 处的半径，且 BC 垂直于 OB，所以 BC 是圆 O 在 B 点处的切线。
method.answer_answer_check_final:

The line AP is A+t(P-A)=(-pt,r(1-t)). Its second intersection with x^2+y^2=r^2 is obtained from p^2t^2+r^2(1-t)^2=r^2, giving t=2r^2/(p^2+r^2). Thus
B=(-2pr^2/(p^2+r^2), r(p^2-r^2)/(p^2+r^2)).

By CP=BC, we have c-p=BC. Since B lies on the circle,
BC^2=(x_B+c)^2+y_B^2=c^2+2cx_B+r^2.

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the diagram, $AB$ is a chord of $\odot O$. Through point $O$, construct $OC \perp OA$, with $OC$ intersecting $AB$ at point $P$, and $CP = BC$. Point $Q$ is a point on the arc $\overset{\frown}{AmB}$. Prove that: $BC$ is a tangent to $\odot O$.
raw_record.answer: Proof: Connect $OB$. Since $OA = OB$, it follows that $\angle OAB = \angle OBA$. Since $PC = CB$, it follows that $\angle CPB = \angle PBC$. Since $\angle APO = \angle CPB$, it follows that $\angle APO = \angle CBP$. Since $OC \perp OA$, it follows that $\angle AOP = 90^\circ$. Thus, $\angle OAP + \angle APO = 90^\circ$. Thus, $\angle CBP + \angle ABO = 90^\circ$. Thus, $\angle CBO = 90^\circ$. Therefore, $BC$ is a tangent to $\odot O$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there is a circle with O as the center, A, B, Q are on the circle, and AB is a chord of the circle and intersects the line from C through P to O at P. Segment OC passes through O, P, C, and in the figure OA is perpendicular to OC. C is outside the circle on the left side, and CB is connected; BQ is also drawn, Q is located on the lower-right arc, but Q does not need to be used in this proof.

Reasoning: Connect OB. Because A and B are both on circle O, OA and OB are both radii, hence OA = OB. Therefore triangle AOB is an isosceles triangle, obtaining ∠OAB = ∠ABO. Also because P is on AB, ∠OAP = ∠OAB, therefore ∠OAP = ∠ABO.

From the given CP = BC, it can be known that triangle CPB is an isosceles triangle, so ∠CPB = ∠PBC. Since line AB and line OC intersect at point P, ∠CPB and ∠APO are vertical angles, therefore ∠CPB = ∠APO. Thus ∠APO = ∠PBC.

Also because OC ⟂ OA, and P is on OC, ∠AOP = 90°. In right triangle AOP, ∠OAP + ∠APO = 90°. Substituting the above obtained ∠OAP = ∠ABO and ∠APO = ∠PBC, get ∠ABO + ∠PBC = 90°.

Because A, P, B are collinear, ray BA and BP are on the same straight line, hence ∠ABO + ∠PBC exactly form ∠OBC. Therefore ∠OBC = 90°, that is, OB ⟂ BC. Also OB is the radius of circle O at point B, so BC is perpendicular to the radius OB passing through the point of tangency B, hence BC is the tangent line of circle O.
